subject: MAP v1: sequencing MSA/DPA/order-form milestones for Biotune pilot
messages:

To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP v1 + dependencies — sequencing MSA/DPA/order form

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (Biotune_MAP_v1.xlsx) that lays out evaluation milestones and the procurement sequence we discussed. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm which Redwood deliverables must be contractually gated (MSA vs order form).
- Identify the shortest practical signature window if we want a July POC start (our targeted production run).
- Please flag any critical evidence you need for our legal team to sign off on the DPA (SOC 2 artifacts, logging retention table).

I copied Laura since she mentioned legal would need to see a redline and a small evidence bundle. Carlos (procurement) will follow up with PO timing once dates are firm.

Attachment: Biotune_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Amelia
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Biotune Health
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@biotunehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP v1 + dependencies — sequencing MSA/DPA/order form

Amelia — thanks, got the MAP and read through the milestone sheet. Quick notes inline below; attached a slimmed acceptance checklist that maps order-form milestones to the MSA sections we typically bind at signature.

Key asks from our side:
- Can Biotune accept a two-step signature approach? Sign MSA + DPA first (legal completeness), then execute order form for pilot scope and pricing. That lets us start provisioning faster.
- If you need the MSA redlines up front, Laura — can you review the three clauses I flag (data residency, subcontractor list, liability cap) and confirm whether the proposed wording is acceptable as-is? I attached Redwood_MSA_redlines_vK.pdf for quick turnaround.
- For the DPA evidence box: Evidence_Summary_Security.docx lists SOC 2 section references and sample logs we can provide. Laura, we might need to attach that to the MAP as an evidence item.

Proposed timeline (optimistic):
- 6/10: legal alignment complete
- 6/16: signatures (MSA+DPA)
- 6/17–6/25: order form finalize and PO issuance
- 7/01: pilot provisioning (week of)

If those windows are too tight for you, call out the critical blocker and we’ll propose a staggered fallback.

Attachment: Redwood_map_acceptance_checklist.xlsx (new)

Onward — Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@biotunehealth.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP v1 + dependencies — sequencing MSA/DPA/order form

Karthik / Amelia — I reviewed the redlines. High-level:

- Data residency: Acceptable with a single-country designation plus clause that allows temporary cross-border processing for devops (we will add explicit controls).
- Subcontractor list: We can provide a current list; recommend an evergreen clause that requires notification for material changes rather than an exhaustive list in the MSA.
- Liability cap: We propose a compromise tied to annual usage for the pilot (helps both sides avoid a large fixed amount).

Evidence bundle: we can produce the Evidence_Summary_Security.docx and a short SOC 2 artifact index. I put a Google Drive folder together for the Biotune legal team: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Map-Biotune — please use that to drop any procurement paperwork (PO templates, vendor registration).

Timing constraints: legal has a planned review block the week of 6/9; if Biotune can get final comment earlier this week we can hit the 6/16 signature target. If not, expect signature to slip by one to two weeks.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@biotunehealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Carlos Medina <c.medina@biotunehealth.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP v1 + dependencies — sequencing MSA/DPA/order form

Thanks Laura — that clarifies a lot. Carlos (procurement) confirms Biotune is comfortable with the two-step signature approach; PO issuance timing depends on our finance close but target is to have a signed order form and PO by 6/24.

We uploaded our standard supplier setup form and a tentative PO template to the Drive folder. Also, here's a short DocuSign powerform link we prefer for the MSA: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?f=0a1b2c3d

A couple of asks from our security reviewer: can Redwood confirm log retention windows (30 / 90 / 365 days per log type) and whether exportable audit logs are provided for the duration of the pilot? If you can add that as an evidence row in the MAP it will speed sign-off.

On milestones: if Redwood can commit to provisioning within 3 business days of order form signature, we’ll mark the provisioning gate as 3 days in the MAP. Otherwise we should plan a 10-business-day buffer.

Best,
Amelia
From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@biotunehealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP v1 + dependencies — sequencing MSA/DPA/order form

Amelia — can confirm Redwood can meet 3 business days for standard provisioning for the pilot (we have a dedicated onboarding slot the week of 6/30).

We will add a row in the MAP for log retention that maps to the Evidence_Summary_Security docx. Summary for your security reviewer:
- Audit logs (authentication, admin changes): 365 days, exportable as CSV on request
- Request/response short-term traces: 30 days rolling
- Billing and usage reports: 24 months

Karthik — I'll drop the updated MAP (with evidence rows and the provisioning commitment) into the Drive by EOD and link it to the HubSpot deal. Amelia — once you confirm the PO timing we’ll schedule the provisioning slot.

Jordan Blake
